mutants.name: stable-commits-uses-raw-length
mutants.why: stable_commits must count only stability-checked commits, not all non-birth commits; the raw len formula inflates the count for functions with unstable commits and t4 expects exactly 1
mutants.anchor: stable_commits = sum(1 for _, is_stable in commits[:-1] if is_stable)

mutants.name: tie-rule-dropped
mutants.why: ties must be broken by file::name ascending; dropping the tie key lets non-determinism pass undetected and t7 checks the order

mutants.name: glossary-guard-removed
mutants.why: the guard must refuse GLOSSARY.md output paths; disabling the check lets the CLI write the glossary silently and t10 asserts exit 2

mutants.name: role-weights-all-one
mutants.why: role weights must differentiate gate_checker from utility; setting all weights to 1.0 removes the distinction and t8 catches it

mutants.name: projects-parent-hardcoded
mutants.why: PROJECTS_PARENT must be env-derived so paths work on every machine; hardcoding it breaks t2 on any machine whose parent is not /Users/marklehn/Developer/GitHub
